label: Phases with a 512 / 256 wide net, from evo-1
description: Like evolution-9 (plain / smart phases, first hidden layer widened to 512), and the second hidden layer is widened from 64 to 256 as well (HIDDEN2_NEURONS). Starts from evo-1's best net (gen 432), widened so it plays exactly the same. Run this if evolution-9 does not get past the ceiling.
